title: Master in Cybersecurity
description:
## Top programme in Cybersecurity In the era of Cyberphysical Systems (CPS) and Internet of Things (IoT), digital dependency can certainly provide great value in all aspects of our life, but it also increases vulnerabilities to cyber intrusion across every segment of our society: corporations, universities, government, private organizations, and the homes of individual citizens. IoT networks including machinery, cars, phones, homes, and social media platforms are amplifying the potential cyberattack surface. It is estimated that there are already over 21 billion IoT devices worldwide, and their number will double by 2025. A cybersecurity attack on an industrial application, for example, can expand rapidly and put an entire facility at risk. The consequences for operations, people, and equipment can be devastating. Cybersecurity specialists are needed in nearly every area to help close the cybersecurity skills gap and to assist companies, governments, and organizations in remaining on top of cyber risk prevention and management. Your program offers a range of benefits not available in comparable programs: - Broadest available training in a full range of cybersecurity areas such as cyber-physical systems security, cyber risk assessment, penetration testing, digital forensics, and cloud security - Multidisciplinary collaboration with Robotics and Automation and the Division of Law, Economics, Statistics and Politics at University West - Balance of theoretical knowledge with hands-on experience in the industry - Program content aligned with key international standards, such as the NIST and NICE cybersecurity frameworks and top cybersecurity skills - Optional participation in courses offering complimentary training for additional certifications, such as CCNA cybersecurity "CyberOps" certification ## International focus Students from around the globe come together in your program to create a unique and international environment. The program is fully taught in English, and you will study together with students from Sweden as well as international students from countries in Asia, Europe, Africa, and North and South America. Most of your instructors also have international experience in both research and education. This will enhance your cultural experience and English-language proficiency. ## Work Integrated Learning University West is Sweden's leading university when it comes to work-integrated learning (WIL). The university was tasked with the development of WIL by the Swedish government 15+ years ago and continues to lead the field today. WIL allows you to focus on problem-based learning for industry, with real projects from partner companies. Your specialization in cybersecurity has been built in close collaboration with industry and is founded on the pressing needs of governments and leading companies. Your instructors also have a wealth of industry experience. Industry professionals will help introduce you to the latest best practices within the cybersecurity landscape. Through guest lectures, company visits, and company-proposed topics for degree projects, you'll gain hands-on experience in designing complete security solutions based on real-life case studies. Here, you can discuss your understanding, raise questions and propose ideas to experts in the field – and to potential employers. ## Advanced laboratories and acess to expertis As a cybersecurity specialist, you will have access to advanced labs and equipment. ### Cisco Networking Lab Professional networking equipment in terms of switches, routers, cabling, and server racks
Firewalls to isolate networks for cybersecurity experiments ### A virtualization and VMWare lab For cloud security experiments targeting virtual machines, containers, and microservices ### Industrial robots lab and IoT lab Equipment for experiments around cyber-physical systems security
You'll also have access to the PTC, home to University West's research area Production Technology West (PTW). Here you will have the opportunity to do research together with experienced researchers, engineers, and technicians in the field. There are many companies linked to our research environment. As a student, you will have the opportunity to be part of cutting-edge research and come into contact with future employers.
## A strong job market The industry demand for professionals in cybersecurity has never been higher: - Worldwide cybersecurity personnel shortage of 3.12 million by 2021 (The International Information System Security Certification Consortium) - Worldwide growth of 350% in open cybersecurity positions from 2014 to 2021 (Forbes and Cybersecurity Ventures) - Countries like Australia, France, Germany, Israel, Japan, Mexico, the UK, and the US are reporting a severe shortage of cybersecurity skills and education (McAfee and Center for Strategic and International Studies) - Sweden will witness a 100% increase in the cybersecurity job market demand compared to 2017 (The Swedish Council for Higher Education) - The US is on pace to hit a half-million or more unfilled cybersecurity positions by 2021 (Cybersecurity Ventures) ## Further education This program helps you build a strong foundation in cybersecurity and develop the qualifications you need to pursue your Ph.D. in the broader field of computer science with focus areas such as cybersecurity, cyber law, network security, and more.
After graduation, you will be eligible to continue studying as a Ph.D. student at University West or other universities in Sweden and abroad.

title: Master in AI and Automation (2 years)
title_sv: Master in AI and Automation (2 years)
description_sv: ## A growing field for Innovators Do you have an innovative mindset? Get into the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on the ground floor: AI is in the start-up phase of implementation in the industry. As a graduate of this programme, you will be a key player in introducing new ways to deploy AI in the industry. ## **Shaping the future** This programme combines learning in production technology and computer science. This allows you to build unique expertise in both AI and automation, entering the job market as an innovative engineer, where you will shape new production systems and products. This combination is unavailable from most other universities. We built this programme for electrical engineers, mechanical engineers and computer engineers to become production technology engineers with advanced skills in AI and automation. Your curriculum is designed to meet the demands of the industry. An added advantage of studying at University West is that you will also have easy access to the rich research environment at University West. You’ll gain practical experience through assignments as well as group and individual projects in close collaboration with corporate leaders in the industry. The entire programme has been built on the strength of a close collaboration between industry and University West. Every aspect is based on the real hiring needs of companies and research facilities in the industry. ## International environment Students from around the globe come together to create a unique and international environment. Your programme is fully taught in English, and you will study together with students from Sweden as well as international students from countries in Asia, Europe, Africa and North and South America. Most of your instructors also have international experience in both research and education. This will enhance your cultural experience and English-language proficiency. ## Work-integrated learning University West is Sweden’s leading university in work-integrated learning (WIL). title: Master in Electric Engineering
description:
## **Work Integrated Learning** University West is Sweden’s leading university when it comes to work-integrated learning (WIL). The university was tasked with the development of WIL by the Swedish government 15+ years ago and continues to lead the field today. WIL offers you a focus on problem-based learning for industry, with real projects from our research groups and partner companies. - **Courses developed in partnership with industry:** Your training is influenced by the real-world needs of our partner companies. Upon graduation, you will be qualified as a highly skilled and in-demand electric engineer. - **Learn from company experts:** Throughout your studies, you will have opportunities to engage with and learn from company experts through guest lectures, company visits and collaborative work. ## Specialised skills matched to industry needs We worked directly with the industry to build a specialized, advanced-level training that meets the industry's major skills needs in the field of electric vehicles and electrical power engineering. All programme components prepare you for research and development in support of electrical engineering. ## Access to experts and advanced laboratories Your instructors are internationally recognised and many of them are professionally involved in the industry or the active research of IndustryCampus Stallbacka. This collaborative platform offers a unique collection of advanced industrial research technologies: **Track 1 – Electrical Vehicles** - Electric vehicle technology - Measurement technology - Electric machine design - Power electronic systems - Battery technology - Electrical safety
**Track 2 – Electrical Power Systems** - Electrical Power systems - Electrical Power System stability - Simulation tools - Electric machine design - Power electronic systems - Electrical safety - Energy storage technology ## Specialised and personal University West offers an intimate campus environment without the usual barriers between academic staff and students. Here, your professors are easily accessible to answer questions, hold discussions and provide individual feedback. The teacher-to-student ratio is higher than at most comparable programmes at other universities. While large universities have several focus areas, University West’s small size and high quality allow us to dedicate focus and resources to electrical engineering. This ensures a high-quality programme as well as a warm and friendly atmosphere. ## International environment Students from around the globe come together in your programme to create a unique and international environment. The programme is fully taught in English, and you will study together with students from Sweden as well as international students from countries in Asia, Europe, Africa and North and South America. This will enhance your cultural experience and English-language proficiency. ## Strong job market The job market for electrical engineers is extremely good. This programme prepares you for a career in the industry or the academy. This skillset is so sought after that we developed it as a response to industry request.
With training in this rapidly expanding field of technology where innovation is prioritized, you will have the choice between advanced studies or a career in industry, both in Sweden and abroad. In this one-year Master in electrical engineering - programme you will develop an understanding of electric vehicles or electric power systems. Your programme will cover the main aspects of design, testing and development within electric vehicles, with electrical engineering as the foundation. ## Subjects Master in electrical engineering, 60 credits, is a one-year program which includes two dedicated paths: - Electrical vehicle - Electric Power Systems The specific path gives you a unique in-depth knowledge, which the industry today has an urgent need for. As a completed student from the Master in Electrical Engineering, 60 credits, you will receive the degree: - Degree of Master of Science (60 credits) with a major in Electrical Engineering ## Course overview In this international learning environment, you’ll build knowledge in a specialised set of engineering topics as relevant to the automotive industry. An advantage of study at University West, you will also have easy access to the rich research environment in the IndustryCampus Stallbacka.
You’ll gain practical experience through assignments as well as group and individual projects in close collaboration with instructors with industrial experience.
The programme ends with a degree project (thesis work) in the field of either electric drivelines or electrical power engineering.
The entire programme has been built through the collaboration of industry and researchers at University West. Every aspect is based on real hiring needs of companies and research facilities in the industry. The total programme is 60 credits in accordance with the European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System (ECTS). ## Courses **Educational methods** - Taught modules (62.5%) - Group projects (12.5%) - Thesis work (30%) ## Degree Upon completion of this master’s programme you will receive a Degree of Master of Science (60 credits) with a major in Electrical Engineering ## Career Your programme prepares you for the current and future needs of industry, where electrical engineers with specialized within electrical vehicles and electric power engineering are required.
Companies are also looking for engineers with international interpersonal skills to improve effectiveness in global operations – an additional component of this programme. On graduation, you will be highly competitive for positions within the private sector or further advanced studies. ### Potential employers You’ll be highly sought after by multinational corporations world-wide. In addition, multinational companies such as Polestar and Volvo Cars, as well as VOLVO AB and CEVT, are located near University West. These employers are looking for specialized electrical engineers with the international competencies gained in your programme. ## Further education This programme helps you build a strong foundation in the field of electric vehicles or electric power engineering. You can go on to develop the qualifications you need to pursue your PhD in the fields such as: - Electric machines - Battery technology - Power electronics - Measuring technology - Electric power engineering

title: Master in Manufacturing Engineering (1 year)
description_sv:
## About the programme Manufacturing methods strongly affect the design, quality and economy of production. In this program you learn to plan, design, develop and integrate processes, systems, machines and tools for the manufacturing of high-quality products. Fully English-taught, University West’s one-year Master’s Programme in Manufacturing Engineering is designed in close collaboration with industry, incorporating recent methods, new materials and new manufacturing processes. Outstanding features include the integration of real work situations and access to advanced manufacturing laboratories. This one-year program is designed for students with few years of experience as engineers. [There is also a two-year master of manufacturing program which is suitable for new graduates](). ## Why this programme? ### **Advanced laboratories, simulation tools and access to experts** As a manufacturing engineering student, you will have access to our Production Technology Centre (PTC) during your studies. PTC is one of the largest and most up to date manufacturing laboratories in Sweden.
The PTC has been in the field of manufacturing research for over 20 years. This collaborative platform offers a unique collection of manufacturing and related advanced industrial research technologies: - Welding technologies (tungsten inert gas, metal active gas, robotised welding, etc.) - World-leading thermal spraying facilities (plasma- and combustion-based spraying guns) - CNC milling and turning equipment - AM-specific technologies (powder bed fusion techniques such as electron beam melting, directed-energy deposition techniques such as laser metal deposition with wire and powder as well as wire-arc, etc.) - Measurement and control systems for in situ monitoring and inspection - Advanced manufacturing process modelling and simulations tools Most research projects at PTC address metallic materials such as high-strength steels, stainless steels, superalloys, aluminium- and titanium-based light materials, metallic and ceramic coatings, biomaterials and nanoengineered materials. PTC is also equipped with advanced materials testing and characterisation laboratories to explore the process-microstructure-properties-performance relationship of the materials. **
Testing and characterisation equipment** - Microstructural inspection and microanalysis including optical microscopy and scanning electron microscopy - Geometrical and surface topography assessment using 3D profilometry - Phase analysis using X-ray diffractometry - Mechanical testing including microhardness, tensile, creep and fatigue at room and high temperatures - Thermomechanical simulation and testing using a Gleeble welding simulator - Weldability testing using Varestraint (Variable-Restraint) technique - Wear, corrosion, and electrochemical investigations in various environments at room and high temperatures - Non-destructive testing using ultrasound, X-ray, infrared camera, and eddy current, etc. - Machining dynamics measurement and test equipment such as rotating and stationary dynamometers, impact hammers and accelerometers. **
Simulation Tools** - Advanced high-end CAD/CAM/CAE: Siemens NX - Welding and Additive manufacturing: Simufact additive, Simufact welding - FEM: COMSOL multiphysics, MSC Marc - Computational material science: Thermo-calc, DICTRA, TCPRISMA You will be introduced to some of the above equipment during your courses, and you may work with some of them directly based on the topic of your thesis. ## Study Environment The PTC is home to University West’s research area Production Technology West (PTW). Here you will have the opportunity to do research and experimental work together with experienced researchers, engineers and technicians in the field. There are many companies linked to our research environment. As a student, you will have the opportunity to be part of cutting-edge research and meet possible future employers. University West offers an intimate campus environment without the usual barriers between academic staff and students. Here, your professors are easily accessible to answer questions, hold discussions and provide individual feedback. The teacher-to-student ratio is higher than at most comparable programmes at other universities.
While large universities have several focus areas, University West’s small size and high quality allow us to dedicate focus and resources to a few prioritised/selected areas, such as manufacturing engineering. This ensures a high-quality programme as well as a warm and friendly atmosphere. Students from around the globe come together in your programme to create a unique and international environment. The programme is fully taught in English, and you will study together with students from Sweden as well as international students from Europe, Asia and elsewhere. Most of your instructors also have international experience in both research and education. Some of these students have continued their studies in the PhD level, as in addition to a career **in industry, your competence in Manufacturing Engineering will open doors to advanced studies and research both in Sweden and abroad.** ## Work Integrated Learning University West is Sweden’s leading university for Work Integrated Learning (WIL). The university was tasked with the development of WIL by the Swedish government in 2002 and continues to lead the field today. WIL allows you to put your knowledge and skills into practice within real-world contexts. The courses in manufacturing engineering program have been developed in close collaboration with Swedish industry considering the needs of the companies representing the sector. Your courses are taught by instructors that belong to the research group Production Technology West, an internationally recognized research group within the field of manufacturing engineering.

Upon completion of this master’s programme, you will receive a Master of Science (MSc, 60 credits) in Mechanical Engineering with a specialization in manufacturing engineering. ### Two-year master's programme in manufacturing engineering Please note that University West also offers a two-year Master’s Programme in Manufacturing Engineering. The one-year programme is aimed at graduates who have a few years of experience as an engineer, while the two-year programme is aimed at students who (recently) received their bachelor’s degree and want to improve their mastery of manufacturing processes through the use of more scientific tools and/or initiate a research career. ### Programme Syllabus [Download the programme syllabus](). ## Career Manufacturing represents a notable section of economic activities in developed countries. Companies of all sizes need manufacturing engineers to handle tasks and challenges relevant to manufacturing processes. These challenges include design and development of manufacturing processes, design of new manufacturing methods or improving existing methods. From this master’s programme, you will gain skills to enhance your career in different sectors of the manufacturing field. On graduation, you will be highly competitive for positions within the private sector or further PhD studies. ## Further Education After graduating from this master’s programme you will be eligible to continue studying as a PhD student in Sweden or elsewhere. University West offers a doctoral degree programme within the field of production technology.

title: Master in Robotics and Automation (2 years)
title_sv: Master in Robotics and Automation (2 years)
description_sv:
## We live in the era of robots There is an ongoing digitalisation of societies all around the world, and this has brought about an explosive growth in the use of robots and automation solutions, a development that implicates not only industry but entire cultures. What we are witnessing is the fourth industrial revolution (Industry 4.0). We not only have smart robots, but units with sensors and inbuilt systems that are connected to networks (Internet of Things, IoT), making up the foundation for smart factories. Advanced simulation models (digital twins) and artificial intelligence (AI) are going to be commonplace in industries. The courses that make up the programme offer you in-depth knowledge of smart factories and prepare you well for contributing to their development. You learn design and programming of robots and automation systems in virtual reality (VR) as well as augmented reality (AR). The entire programme has been created through collaboration between the industry and researchers at University West. ## Qualifications The programme is offered as two different qualifications as well as in two different teaching models. \- 60 HE Master in Robotics and Automation (1 year) offers in-depth knowledge of automation, robotics, digitalisation, and virtual environments with the aim of preparing you for a career as an automation specialist in the industry. - [Campus-based education at University West in Trollhättan](), Sweden. - [Web-based distance learning with two physical meetings at University West in Trollhättan](), Sweden.
\- 120 HE Master in Robotics and Automation (2 years) offers in-depth knowledge of automation, robotics, digitalisation, and virtual environments, as well as a higher degree of independence in problem-solving and innovative thinking, with the aim of preparing you for a career in research and development in the industry or academy. - [Campus-based education at University West in Trollhättan](), Sweden. ## Future careers Upon completing this programme, you will be very much sought after on the job market. Your future profession will allow you to work with programming, simulation, and deployment of industrial robot and automation systems or as project manager for design and development of new automation solutions. Many of the international students who graduate from our programme apply for jobs in Sweden and stay on to work here. ## Production Technology Centre (PTC) Some modules of the programme take place at the Production Technology Centre (PTC). The PTC is a part of University West and is located at the Innovatum center in Trollhättan. Here you will find a lab that meets the highest international standards as well as University West´s research area [Production Technology West (PTW)](). At PTW we conduct research in flexible industrial automation in conjunction with industry. There are many companies linked to our research environment and research takes place in close cooperation with industry. As a student, you will have the opportunity not only to be part of cutting-edge research, you will also come into contact with future employers. ## Work-Integrated Learning - WIL We are Sweden’s leading university when it comes to WIL (work-integrated learning). At University West, you can work toward an academic degree and get work experience at the same time. You will attend lectures, carry out practical tasks, do lab work and projects. The coursework is mostly in the form of problem-based learning, often in conjunction with industry or case studies from industry. ## International admissions The programme has international admissions, which means that students from all over the world can apply. All instruction is in English and you study together with both Swedish and foreign students. This gives you both linguistic and cultural experience. ## Further Education After graduating from one of these master’s programmes you will be eligible to continue studying as a PhD student. University West offers a doctoral degree programme within the field of Production Technology.

title: Master in Operations and Supply Chain Management
description_sv:
## Prepare to make an impact This master’s programme shows you how to build smart production and logistics systems that serve the needs of society and contribute to sustainable development. It is uniquely holistic, giving you insights into both the technical and organisational aspects of management, design, planning and development of industrial operations and supply chains. You’ll learn how to use information technology (including data mining and machine learning) to help control, design, plan and develop competitive and sustainable production and supply chain systems. You’ll also gain a solid foundation across logistics and operations management, preparing you to improve a business’s strategies, organisations and operational work in a more sustainable way. ## Advanced laboratories and access to experts You will have access to our Production Technology Centre (PTC) during your studies. PTC is one of the largest and most updated manufacturing laboratories in Sweden. The PTW has been supporting the work of experts in production technology for over 15 years. This collaborative platform offers a unique collection of research technologies related to logistics and operations. It also provides opportunities for collaboration within a new research group for operations management and supply chain management. Academic and corporate connections
The PTC is home to University West’s research area, Production Technology West (PTW). Here you will have the opportunity to do research together with experienced researchers, engineers and technicians in the field of production engineering. There are many companies linked to our research environment. As a student, you will have the opportunity to be part of cutting-edge research and come into contact with future employers. ## Work Integrated Learning University West is Sweden’s leading university in work-integrated learning (WIL). We were tasked with the development of WIL by the Swedish government 17+ years ago and continue to lead the field today. This approach focuses on problem-based learning for industry and gives you access to real projects from partner companies and research centres. Your courses and teachers are connected to the active research of Production Technology West (PTW), internationally recognised for work in production systems and processes in the manufacturing industry. We built your programme in close collaboration with corporate partners – and your programme can also include an optional internship. The skills you’ll develop make you very valuable to employers. The programme also offers a pathway to doctoral studies with a Work-Integrated Learning approach or a focus within the area of Production Systems. ## International environment Students from around the globe come together to create a unique and international environment. Your programme is fully taught in English, and you will study together with students from Sweden as well as international students from countries in Asia, Europe, Africa and North and South America. Most of your instructors also have international experience in both research and education. This will enhance your cultural experience and English-language proficiency. ## Preparing for the future This programme’s holistic approach across logistics, operations management and information technology means you’ll be ready to harness the power of data mining and machine learning to positively impact a business’s strategies, organisations and operational work – and create a more sustainable world. Gain insights into both the technical and organisational aspects of management, design, planning and development of industrial operations and supply chains. Subjects/opportunities - Logistics - Operations management - Information technology - Interesting electives such as Supply Chain Resilience and Emergency Logistics, Reshoring, Critical Success Factors in Information Technology (System) Development Projects and more - Engineering courses to deepen your expertise - Optional internship or study-abroad experience ### Research skills Research methodology
Possible industry or research centre project ### Course overview Increasingly complex systems require collaboration, a broad knowledge base, communication, innovation and effective problem-solving. Gain important technical and contextual knowledge from multiple perspectives, including from within the company and across the entire supply chain. You’ll build a holistic view of supply chain management, whether your background is in business administration, industrial economics, engineering and more. title: Master in International Welding Engineering
description_sv:
### About the programme
Upon completion of this programme, you will be prepared to join a team as an innovative engineer, where you will shape new welding technologies and processes. In addition, as the programme integrates knowledge from different areas of welding production in combination with the International Welding Engineering (IWE) syllabus, you are also eligible for presenting at the examinations of the IWE diploma with the Swedish Welding Commission at an extra cost to register for the IWE certification. Subjects - Welding processes and equipment - Material science and Welding metallurgy - Fatigue and design of welded component - Economy and Quality assurance Research skills - Proficiency in operating welding machines and understanding their settings. - Characterization of metals through microstructure analysis. - Understanding material behavior under various welding conditions. - Knowledge of economy, productivity, WPS, quality standards, and inspection techniques. - Knowledge in research methodology. ### Course overview University West, with its long-standing background in welding, is a collaborative platform with a unique ecosystem of equipment relevant to welding engineering. We built this programme for mechanical, manufacturing, materials and marine engineers to become production technology engineers. You’ll gain practical experience through assignments as well as group and individual projects in close collaboration with corporate leaders in the industry. The entire programme has been built on the strength of a close collaboration between industry and University West. Every aspect is based on the real hiring needs of companies and research facilities in the industry.

title: Master in Manufacturing Engineering (2 years)
description_sv:
## About the program Manufacturing methods strongly affect the design, quality and economy of production. In this program you learn to plan, design, develop and integrate processes, systems, machines and tools for the manufacturing of high-quality products. Fully English-taught, University West’s two-year Master’s Programme in Manufacturing Engineering is designed in close collaboration with industry, incorporating recent methods, new materials and new manufacturing processes. The second year can include an industrial placement in Europe, Asia or South America as the basis for your thesis. Outstanding features include the integration of real work situations and access to advanced manufacturing laboratories. This two-year program is designed for new graduates. [There is also a one-year master of manufacturing program which is suitable for students with few years of experience as engineers]() ## Why this programme? ### **Advanced laboratories, simulation tools and access to experts** As a manufacturing engineering student, you will have access to our Production Technology Centre (PTC) during your studies. PTC is one of the largest and most up to date manufacturing laboratories in Sweden.
The PTC has been in the field of manufacturing research for over 20 years. This collaborative platform offers a unique collection of manufacturing and related advanced industrial research technologies: - Welding technologies (tungsten inert gas, metal active gas, robotised welding, etc.) - World-leading thermal spraying facilities (plasma- and combustion-based spraying guns) - CNC milling and turning equipment - AM-specific technologies (powder bed fusion techniques such as electron beam melting, directed-energy deposition techniques such as laser metal deposition with wire and powder as well as wire-arc, etc.) - Measurement and control systems for in situ monitoring and inspection - Advanced manufacturing process modelling and simulations tools Most research projects at PTC address metallic materials such as high-strength steels, stainless steels, superalloys, aluminium- and titanium-based light materials, metallic and ceramic coatings, biomaterials and nanoengineered materials. PTC is also equipped with advanced materials testing and characterisation laboratories to explore the process-microstructure-properties-performance relationship of the materials. ### **Testing and characterisation equipment** - Microstructural inspection and microanalysis including optical microscopy and scanning electron microscopy - Geometrical and surface topography assessment using 3D profilometry - Phase analysis using X-ray diffractometry - Mechanical testing including microhardness, tensile, creep and fatigue at room and high temperatures - Thermomechanical simulation and testing using a Gleeble welding simulator - Weldability testing using Varestraint (Variable-Restraint) technique - Wear, corrosion, and electrochemical investigations in various environments at room and high temperatures - Non-destructive testing using ultrasound, X-ray, infrared camera, and eddy current, etc. - Machining dynamics measurement and test equipment such as rotating and stationary dynamometers, impact hammers, and accelerometers. ### Simulation Tools - Advanced high-end CAD/CAM/CAE: Siemens NX - Welding and Additive manufacturing: Simufact additive, Simufact welding - FEM: COMSOL multiphysics, MSC Marc - Computational material science: Thermo-calc, DICTRA, TCPRISMA You will be introduced to some of the above equipment/simulation tools during your courses, and you may work with some of them, based on the topic of your thesis. ## Study Environment The PTC is home to University West’s research area Production Technology West (PTW). Here you will have the opportunity to do research and experimental work together with experienced researchers, engineers and technicians in the field. There are many companies linked to our research environment. As a student, you will have the opportunity to be part of cutting-edge research and meet possible future employers. University West offers an intimate campus environment without the usual barriers between academic staff and students. Here, your professors are easily accessible to answer questions, hold discussions and provide individual feedback. The teacher-to-student ratio is higher than at most comparable programmes at other universities.
While large universities have several focus areas, University West’s small size and high quality allow us to dedicate focus and resources to a few prioritised/selected areas, such as manufacturing engineering. This ensures a high-quality programme as well as a warm and friendly atmosphere. Students from around the globe come together in your programme to create a unique and international environment. The programme is fully taught in English, and you will study together with students from Sweden as well as international students from Europe, Asia and elsewhere. Most of your instructors also have international experience in both research and education. This will enhance your cultural experience and English-language proficiency. In addition, you will have the option to perform your thesis work at one of our partner companies or universities abroad. ### **Elective course package and internationalization** The second study year includes 30 HE credits in elective courses, allowing students to take courses at another institution of higher education, either in Sweden or abroad. University West is part of an international network of higher education institutions with partners from Europe, Asia and South America. The elective course package further enables you to decide about your specialization within manufacturing engineering by selecting courses specific to your interest. The elective courses provided at University West are adapted for student mobility, allowing to follow courses online or combining an international stay with an industrial placement project. You may also choose to stay in Sweden during your industrial placement. In Sweden, you can apply for working with a Swedish company or within University West’s PTW research environment. ## A strong job market Manufacturing industries make up 10-20% of the economy of developed countries; consequently, there is always a high demand for competent manufacturing engineers. Graduates of the master of manufacturing programmes have been employed in companies such as Volvo Group, Sandvik Materials Technology, GKN Aerospace, Tooltec and many other small and large companies. Some of these students have continued their studies in the PhD level, as in addition to a career in industry, your competence in Manufacturing Engineering will open doors to advanced studies in PhD level and research both in Sweden and abroad. ## Work Integrated Learning University West is Sweden’s leading university for Work Integrated Learning (WIL). The university was tasked with the development of WIL by the Swedish government in 2002 and continues to lead the field today. WIL allows you to put your knowledge and skills into practice within real-world contexts. The courses in manufacturing engineering program have been developed in close collaboration with Swedish industry considering the needs of the companies representing the sector. Your courses are taught by instructors that belong to the research group Production Technology West, an internationally recognized research group within the field of manufacturing engineering.
This WIL approach offers you a focus on problem-based learning for industry, with real projects from PTW and partner companies. Your training concludes with an international industry placement or working within the PTW research group, followed by a master’s thesis project in industry or academia. ## **More about the** programme This programme presents multiple crucial manufacturing technologies and their scientific bases, along with related scientific developments and ongoing challenges. Master of these subjects will enable you to effectively control and monitor these processes, considering the impact of processes on materials. **Course Overview** In this interdisciplinary learning environment, you’ll build knowledge across a broad range of engineering topics. An advantage of study at University West, you will also have easy access to the rich research environment in the PTC and PTW. The total programme is 120 credits per the European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System (ECTS). ### YEAR 1 **Autumn** - Advanced Materials Science, 6 credits - Additive Manufacturing Processes, 7.5 credits - Surface Engineering, 7.5 credits - Machining, 6 credits - Academic writing, 3 credits **Spring** - Computer Aided Manufacturing, 3 credits - Welding Processes, 6 credits - Thermal Spraying, 6 credits - Metallurgy of Welding and Additive Manufacturing, 7.5 credits - Non-Destructive Evaluation, 4 credits - Materials Characterization and Testing, 3.5 credits ### **YEAR 2** **Autumn** During the autumn you will need to take your industrial placement. The courses are optional and offered online, allowing flexibility for you to take them along with your industrial placement if it was necessary. - Industrial Placement, (In Sweden or abroad), 15 credits (Elective) - Statistical Process Control and Design of Experiments, 7.5 credits (Elective) - Process Simulation and Modelling, 7.5 credits (Elective) You can also spend the autumn semester as an exchange student in one of our partner universities, and gaining required credits (30 credits) from your host university.
**Spring** - Master's Thesis in Mechanical Engineering, 30 credits (In Sweden or abroad) ## Degree Upon completion of this master’s programme, you will receive a Master of Science (MSc, 120 credits) in Mechanical Engineering with a specialization in manufacturing engineering. **One-year Master´s Programme in Manufacturing Engineering**
Please note that University West also offers a one-year Master’s Programme in Manufacturing Engineering. While the two-year programme is aimed at students who (recently) received their bachelor’s degree and want to develop their knowledge in the field of manufacturing engineering, the one-year programme is aimed at graduates who have a few years of experience as an engineer and want to improve their mastery of manufacturing processes through the use of more scientific tools and/or initiate a research career. ## Career Manufacturing represents a notable section of economic activities in developed countries. Companies of all sizes need manufacturing engineers to handle tasks and challenges relevant to manufacturing processes. These challenges include design and development of manufacturing processes, design of new manufacturing methods or improving existing methods. From this master’s programme, you will gain skills that enhance your career in different sectors of the manufacturing field. Upon graduation, you will be highly competitive for positions within the private sector or further PhD studies. ## **Further** education This programme helps you build a strong foundation in the field and develop the qualifications you need to pursue your PhD in Manufacturing Engineering.
After graduating from this master’s programme you will be eligible to continue studying as a PhD student in Sweden or elsewhere. University West offers a doctoral degree programme within the field of production technology.

title: Master programme in English
description: The Master program in English is for you if you wish to develop your skills in understanding, analyzing, and contextualizing cultural expressions or language use in English, one of the globally most influential languages in contemporary life. You choose whether you want to study primarily linguistic or literary courses or a mix of the two. Are you interested in popular culture and genre literature? Social media? Global English literature or communication? Language learning? This program offers opportunities to immerse yourself in these topics and more! The diverse forms of the English language are extensively present in public and private life, as well as in both local and international culture. The study of English use and English-language cultural expression is therefore concretely relevant and has many potential applications across domains such as education and academia, politics, culture, media, business, and more. The theme of the program is "English in contemporary life". The linguistic courses concern mainly applied linguistics, with an overall focus on perspectives and methods for studying and understanding language use as social interaction, cognition, text, and discourse. The literary courses concern cultural and literary negotiations of contemporary life, with an emphasis on historical and geographical contextualizations as well as critical perspectives. The program's courses highlight contemporary language use and materials, as well as contemporary theories and methods, and are intimately tied to research specializations at the department. The courses do not merely concern the English language and English literature in themselves, but also concern how linguistic and literary perspectives can shed light on societal phenomena, issues, and developments. The program is based on online daytime seminars, which require active participation.
description_sv: Masterprogrammet i engelska är för dig som vill fördjupa din förmåga att förstå, analysera och kontextualisera kulturyttringar eller språkbruk inom ett av samtidens globalt viktigaste språk. Du väljer själv om du vill studera huvudsakligen litteratur- eller språkvetenskapliga kurser, eller en blandning av dessa. Är du intresserad av populärkultur och genrefiktion? Sociala medier? Global engelskspråkig litteratur eller kommunikation? Språkinlärning? Inom programmet finns möjlighet att fördjupa sig i dessa ämnen och mer därtill! Det engelska språkets mångfaldiga former har en utpräglad närvaro i offentligheten och i mångas privatliv, så väl som i lokal och internationell kultur. Studiet av engelskans bruk och kulturyttringar har därför påtaglig relevans och många tillämpningsmöjligheter i en rad domäner, så som inom utbildning och akademi, politik, kultur, media och näringsliv. Programmets tema är "engelska i samtiden". De innehåller språkvetenskapliga kurser som berör olika grenar av tillämpad språkvetenskap, med ett övergripande fokus på perspektiv och metoder för att studera och förstå språkbruk som social interaktion, kognition, text och diskurs. De litteraturvetenskapliga kurserna studerar kulturella och litterära förhandlingar av samtiden, med en tonvikt på historiska och geografiska kontextualiseringar och kritiska perspektiv. Programmets kurser fokuserar på samtida språkbruk och material, såväl som samtida teorier och metoder, och är starkt knutna till ämnesmiljöns forskning. Kurserna behandlar inte bara det engelska språket och den engelska litteraturen i sig, utan även hur språkliga och litterära perspektiv kan belysa samhälleliga fenomen, problem och utvecklingar. De flesta av programmets kurser består av seminarier som ges dagtid på distans och kräver aktivt deltagande.

The study of English use and English-language cultural expression is therefore concretely relevant and has many potential applications across domains such as education and academia, politics, culture, media, business, and more. The theme of the program is "English in contemporary life". The linguistic courses concern mainly applied linguistics, with an overall focus on perspectives and methods for studying and understanding language use as social interaction, cognition, text, and discourse. The literary courses concern cultural and literary negotiations of contemporary life, with an emphasis on historical and geographical contextualizations as well as critical perspectives. The program's courses highlight contemporary language use and materials, as well as contemporary theories and methods, and are intimately tied to research specializations at the department. The courses do not merely concern the English language and English literature in themselves, but also concern how linguistic and literary perspectives can shed light on societal phenomena, issues, and developments. The program is based on online daytime seminars, which require active participation.
eligibility: A Degree of Bachelor of at least 180 credits, including 90 credits with progressive specialisation in the main field of English or equivalent. An independent project of at least 15 credits at G2E level must be included. In addition, upper secondary school English 6 or English level 2.

Studiet av engelskans bruk och kulturyttringar har därför påtaglig relevans och många tillämpningsmöjligheter i en rad domäner, så som inom utbildning och akademi, politik, kultur, media och näringsliv. De flesta av programmets kurser består av seminarier som ges dagtid på distans och kräver aktivt deltagande.

title: Master Programme in Music
description: Would you like to share your passion for music on a global level, working all over the world? With a master’s degree, you will be an excellent musician and soloist with high ambitions. This will bring you opportunities at an international level, and you will have a prominent role wherever you perform. At Ingesund Music School, we offer a calm, scenic environment with considerable access to practice rooms, as well as plenty of recording opportunities. In close collaboration with our three professors of voice, piano and string instruments, you will have great opportunities to develop as a musician, gain deeper artistic knowledge and specialise your craft and your profile. You will also have the opportunity to play in both large and small ensembles such as string orchestras, symphonic orchestras, brass orchestras, vocal ensembles and choirs. Together, we build up your personal brand and profile as an international performer. The master’s programme in music prepares you for the possibility of, after completing the programme, applying for postgraduate studies in the subject of musical performance.
description_sv: Vill du dela din passion för musik på en global nivå med hela världen som arbetsplats? Med en masterexamen öppnar sig möjligheter som artist på en internationell nivå där du som excellent musiker och solist har ett högt mål och får en framträdande roll i de sammanhang du uppträder i. På Musikhögskolan Ingesund erbjuder vi en harmonisk, naturnära miljö med stor tillgång till övnings- och utbildningsrum och goda inspelningsmöjligheter. Här får du, i nära samarbete med våra tre professorer i sång, piano och stråkinstrument möjlighet att utveckla dig som musiker och fördjupa dina konstnärliga kunskaper, ditt hantverk och ditt ID. Du får också möjlighet att spela i stora och små ensembler så som stråkorkester, symfoniorkester, blåsorkester, vokalensemble och körer. Tillsammans bygger vi ditt varumärke som internationell artist. Programmet konstnärlig master musiker (KMM) förbereder dig och ger dig, efter avlagd examen, möjlighet att söka forskarutbildning inom ämnet musikalisk gestaltning.

title: Master Programme in Biology: Ecology and Conservation Biology
title_sv: Masterprogram i biologi: Ekologi och naturvård
description: The programme focuses on Ecology and Conservation and is led by researchers in the Biology department at Karlstad University. It is a programme for those who want to deepen their knowledge and competence in ecology and conservation to prepare for employment or further research. We focus on applied ecology and conservation issues.
description_sv: Vill du bidra till ett hållbart utnyttjande av naturresurser? Vill du fördjupa dina kunskaper och din kompetens inom ekologi och naturvård för framtida arbete eller forskning inom området? Masterprogrammet i biologi: Ekologi och naturvård ger dig fördjupade kunskaper om hur människan påverkar olika terrestra och akvatiska ekosystem, och vilka åtgärder som kan vidtas för att bevara biodiversitet och värdefulla habitat. Programmet har nära koppling till den starka forskningsmiljön i biologi vid Karlstads universitet, inriktad mot främst sötvattensekologi med fokus på rinnande vatten, samt mot miljövård. Dina lärare är aktiva forskare, och du får i varje kurs kontakt med forskningsprojekt och tillämpningar i samhället inom ekologi och naturvård. Du kan följa programmet både som campus- och som distansstudent. Du möter en utbildningsmiljö som kännetecknas av nära kontakt mellan studenter och lärare, och ett starkt engagemang för utbildning och forskning inom ekologi, naturvård och ett hållbart naturresursnyttjande. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Master Programme in Information Systems
description: The Master Programme in Information Systems is a Master´s level, two-year programme with a major in Information Systems, and with an option to complete one's studies after one year obtaining a 1-year Master's exam. The programme offers students the opportunity to deepen their knowledge within the Information Systems field and to develop the skills needed to analyse and design e-service architectures across organisational and technical system boundaries. The programme welcomes international students. All instructions and communication will be in English.
description_sv:
Masterprogrammet i informatik/informationssystem är ett program på avancerad nivå för dig som vill fördjupa dina kunskaper om hur människor utvecklar och använder e-tjänster för att stödja olika verksamheter i företag och samhälle.
Som student kan du fördjupa dig i kurser inom AR/VR (augmented / virtual reality), interaktionsdesign, affärssystem, eller i andra inriktningar genom kurser anslutna till forskningsprojekt. Vi har forskningsprojekt inom bland annat AI (artificiell intelligens), BI (business intelligence), e-Hälsa, personlig integritet, krisledningsstöd, och processmodellering. Tyngdpunkten inom varje område ligger på e-tjänster. Det finns möjlighet att studera till magisterexmen (1 år) inom masterprogrammets ram.

title: AI, Communications, and Social Transformation: Strategy and Critique
title_sv: AI, kommunikation och social transformation: strategi och kritik (Internationell antagningsomgång)
description: **How is artificial intelligence reshaping the way we communicate, work, participate in society, and make decisions? How do digital platforms influence public debate, identity, trust, and opinion? What happens when communication is increasingly shaped by algorithms, datafication, and AI-generated content? And how can organisations use AI and digital technologies strategically while also taking responsibility for ethics, sustainability, transparency, and inclusion?** Digitalisation and artificial intelligence are transforming communication, organisations, media, and society at an unprecedented pace. They create new possibilities for innovation, participation, and knowledge exchange, but also raise urgent questions about inequality, disinformation, surveillance, trust, accessibility, and power. The Master’s Programme in ***AI, Communications, and Social Transformation: Strategy and Critique*** gives you the knowledge and analytical tools to understand these transformations - to act within them. You will explore how AI, digital platforms, and communication strategies shape organisations and societies, while developing the ability to critically assess their consequences and strategic potential. By combining critical perspectives with practical and strategic approaches, the programme prepares you to analyse complex digital environments, develop responsible communication strategies, and contribute to sustainable digital transformation. It is particularly relevant for students interested in careers such as digital strategist, communication strategist, content strategist, social media manager, analyst, project manager in digital development, consultant in digital transformation, or researcher. **Education level:** Master's level ### Prerequisites A Bachelor's degree comprising at least 180 higher education credits, of which at least 90 credits must be in Media and Communication Studies or a related field, such as Journalism, Sociology, Political Science, Human Geography, Social Sciences, Cultural Studies, or Film and Television Studies. In addition, applicants must have English proficiency equivalent to Swedish upper secondary school course English 6 or English Level 2.
description_sv: **Hur förändrar artificiell intelligens sättet vi kommunicerar, arbetar, deltar i samhället och fattar beslut? Hur påverkar digitala plattformar offentlig debatt, identitet, tillit och opinionsbildning? Vad händer när kommunikationen i allt högre grad formas av algoritmer, datafiering och AI-genererat innehåll? Och hur kan organisationer använda AI och digital teknik strategiskt och samtidigt ta ansvar för etik, hållbarhet, transparens och inkludering?** Digitalisering och artificiell intelligens förändrar kommunikation, organisationer, medier och samhälle i snabb takt. Utvecklingen skapar nya möjligheter för innovation, deltagande och kunskapsutbyte, men väcker också angelägna frågor om ojämlikhet, desinformation, övervakning, tillit, tillgänglighet och makt. Masterprogrammet ***AI, Kommunikation och Social Transformation: Strategi och Kritik*** ger dig kunskap och analytiska verktyg för att förstå dessa förändringar - och för att kunna agera i dem. Du får fördjupa dig i hur AI, digitala plattformar och kommunikationsstrategier formar organisationer och samhällen, samtidigt som du utvecklar förmågan att kritiskt granska deras konsekvenser och strategiska möjligheter. Genom att kombinera kritiska perspektiv med praktiska och strategiska angreppssätt förbereder programmet dig för att analysera komplexa digitala miljöer, utveckla ansvarsfulla kommunikationsstrategier och bidra till en hållbar digital transformation. Programmet är särskilt relevant för dig som vill arbeta som exempelvis digital strateg, kommunikationsstrateg, innehållsstrateg, social media manager, analytiker, projektledare inom digital utveckling, konsult inom digital transformation eller forskare.

title: Master Programme in Management: Sustainable Value Creation
description: Are you interested in business management in a rapidly changing business environment facing societal challenges? Then Karlstad Business School's new master's programme is the right choice for you! After completing the programme, you will be qualified to take on strategic roles such as sustainability manager or other key positions where sustainability and leadership go hand in hand. Sustainable value creation - for a better world. We are living in a time of change, where the world needs leaders who not only strive to create success for their organisations but also are able to navigate complex societal challenges and contribute to a sustainable future. Karlstad Business School has taken the step forward with the Master Programme in Management: Sustainable Value Creation. This a unique opportunity for those who wish to be a part of shaping tomorrow's companies and organisations - for a better world.
description_sv: Vill du arbeta med att leda företag i en föränderlig affärsmiljö med samhälleliga utmaningar? Då är Handelshögskolans nya masterprogram något för dig. Efter avslutad utbildning är du kvalificerad för att axla strategiska roller som hållbarhetschef eller andra nyckelpositioner där hållbarhet och ledarskap går hand i hand. Vi befinner oss i en tid av förändring, där världen behöver ledare som inte bara strävar efter att skapa framgång för sina organisationer, utan som också kan navigera komplexa samhällsutmaningar och bidra till en hållbar framtid. Handelshögskolan har tagit steget framåt med det nya Masterprogram i Management: hållbart värdeskapande. Detta är en unik möjlighet för dig som vill vara med och forma morgondagens företag och organisationer - för en bättre värld.

title: Master programme in applied economics and advanced analytical methods
title_sv: Masterprogram i tillämpad nationalekonomi och avancerade analysmetoder
description:
Are you ready to step into a world where data and economics shape the future? title: Master programme: Spatial and Social Transformations
title_sv: Masterprogram: Samhällets rumsliga och sociala omvandlingar
description: Are you ready to understand and analyse how society is changing in a world characterised by global flows, digitalisation and new mobility patterns? Then this Master's programme in Human Geography is just right for you! The programme offers an in-depth and inspiring introduction to how societies are shaped and reshaped through spatial processes and global flows, with a strong foundation in human geography. You will explore how digitalisation, mobility and socio-economic shifts are changing the relationship between urban and rural areas and creating new geographical realities. Through critical perspectives on spatial transformation, you will gain analytical tools to understand how place, power and identity are produced and challenged in a rapidly changing world. The programme thus provides a broad and in-depth understanding of the interplay between local and global dynamics that drive social change. By working with concepts such as tourismo- scenes and place design, you explore how tourism redefines identity, resource use and development strategies. Case studies and fieldwork allow you to investigate the complex interactions between cultural heritage, climate, energy and regional growth in practice. At the same time, the programme integrates issues of crises, resilience and geopolitical changes to understand how mobility and security are redrawing contemporary geographies. The result is a rich toolbox of analytical perspectives on social transformation. The programme provides you with advanced methodological skills through a combination of qualitative, quantitative, digital and field-based methods, together with in-depth knowledge of scientific theory, research design and critical analysis. You will gain insight into how power, justice and sustainability shape spatial decisions and planning processes, and how these issues can be studied in a systematic and reflexive way. The independent research work trains your ability to connect theory and empirical evidence and develop an academic approach. As a student, you will become an active part of the subject's research environment with access to seminars, research discussions and close dialogue with researchers and practitioners in the field. Most of the programme's courses are also independent, which means that you will most likely study alongside international students and gain an even broader understanding of global perspectives on social change.
description_sv: **Är du redo att förstå och själv analysera hur samhället förändras i en värld präglad av globala flöden, digitalisering och nya mobilitetsmönster? Då är detta masterprogram i kulturgeografi helt rätt för dig!** Programmet erbjuder en fördjupad och inspirerande ingång till hur samhällen formas och omformas genom rumsliga processer och globala flöden, med stark förankring i kulturgeografi. Du utforskar hur digitalisering, mobilitet och socioekonomiska skiften förändrar relationerna mellan stad och landsbygd och skapar nya geografiska verkligheter. Genom kritiska perspektiv på rumslig transformation får du analytiska verktyg att förstå hur plats, makt och identitet produceras och utmanas i en snabbt föränderlig värld. Programmet ger en bred och samtidigt fördjupad förståelse för samspelet mellan lokala och globala dynamiker som driver samhällsförändring. Genom att arbeta med begrepp som tourismoscene och platsdesign utforskar du hur turism omdefinierar identitet, resursanvändning och utvecklingsstrategier. Fallstudier och fältmoment låter dig undersöka komplexa samspel mellan kulturarv, klimat, energi och regional tillväxt i praktiken. Samtidigt integrerar programmet frågor om kriser, resiliens och geopolitiska förändringar för att förstå hur mobilitet och säkerhet omritar samtidens geografier. Resultatet är en rik verktygslåda av analytiska perspektiv på samhällsomvandling. Studierna ger dig avancerad metodkompetens genom kombinationen av kvalitativa, kvantitativa, digitala och fältbaserade metoder, tillsammans med fördjupning i vetenskapsteori, forskningsdesign och kritisk analys. Du får insikt i hur makt, rättvisa och hållbarhet formar rumsliga beslut och planeringsprocesser, och hur dessa frågor kan studeras på ett systematiskt och reflexivt sätt. Det självständiga forskningsarbetet tränar din förmåga att koppla samman teori och empiri och utveckla ett akademiskt förhållningssätt. Som student blir du en aktiv del av ämnets forskningsmiljö med tillgång till seminarier, forskningsdiskussioner och nära dialog med forskare och praktiker inom fältet. Flertalet av programmets kurser är dessutom fristående, vilket innebär att du med stor sannolikhet studerar tillsammans med internationella studenter och får en ännu bredare förståelse för globala perspektiv på samhällsförändring.

title: Master Programme in Marketing
description:
**Are you aiming for a career in marketing? Graduates from the Master Programme in Marketing at Karlstad Business School are equipped to work as, for example, head of marketing, head of sales or marketing consultant.**
A master-level programme in marketing provides an understanding for the role of marketing when an organisation is working towards meeting different needs and challenges in contemporary society and markets. The study programme is an excellent starting point for those who want to work with strategic business issues, market analyses, sales and market communication. Karlstad Business School at Karlstad University is AACSB accredited, which means that you as students receive an education that meets international requirements and will be well equipped for any future challenges. It also provides the option of being an exchange student at internationally reputable universities abroad.
description_sv:
**Siktar du mot en karriär inom marknadsföringsområdet? Masterprogrammet i marknadsföring vid Handelshögskolan ger dig goda förutsättningar för att arbeta som exempelvis marknadschef, försäljningschef eller marknadskonsult.**
En utbildning på avancerad nivå i marknadsföring ger dig en förståelse för marknadsföringens roll i organisationers arbete med att möta olika behov och utmaningar i dagens samhälle och marknader. Utbildningen är en utmärkt utgångspunkt för dig som vill arbeta med marknadsstrategiska frågeställningar, marknadsanalyser, försäljning och marknadskommunikation. Handelshögskolan vid Karlstads universitet är AACSB-ackrediterad vilket betyder att du som student får en utbildning som motsvarar internationella krav och står väl rustad inför framtidens utmaningar. Det ger dig även möjligheter till utbytesstudier vid internationellt välrenommerade lärosäten.

title: Master Programme in Accounting and Control
description:
**Do you want to become an accountant, financial manager or controller? In that case, a study programme in Business Administration, specialising in Accounting and Control, could be perfect for you.**
With a masters in Accounting and Control from Karlstad Business School at Karlstad University, you will have up-to-date knowledge about the latest developments in the field, as well as skills that will make you well-equipped for a future career within both the private and public sectors. An international perspective permeates the study programme. Karlstad Business School at Karlstad University is AACSB accredited, which means that you as students receive an education that meets international requirements and will be well equipped for any future challenges. It also provides the option of being an exchange student at internationally reputable universities abroad.

title: Master in Computer Science
description_sv: Detta program är ett 2-årigt program som bygger på en 3-årig kandidatexamen i datavetenskap eller motsvarande. Målet är att förse studenten med avancerade kunskaper inom datavetenskap och i synnerhet inom datasäkerhet, datakommunikation och trådlösa nätverk.
search_description: Detta program är ett 2-årigt program som bygger på en 3-årig kandidatexamen i datavetenskap eller motsvarande. Målet är att förse studenten med avancerade kunskaper inom datavetenskap och i synnerhet inom datasäkerhet, datakommunikation och trådlösa nätverk.
eligibility: General entry requirements. title: Master in Mechanical Engineering - Specialization Data-driven Mechanical Engineering
title_sv: Masterprogram i maskinteknik - inriktning datadriven maskinteknik (Internationell antagningsomgång)
description: The Master’s programme in Data-Driven Mechanical Engineering offers a unique blend of mechanical engineering and data science, preparing students to tackle modern engineering challenges using computational tools, machine learning, and simulation technologies. The programme is designed for students with a background in mechanical engineering, materials science, or related fields who want to deepen their expertise in digital and data-driven methods.
description_sv: Masterprogrammet i datadriven maskinteknik erbjuder en unik blandning av maskinteknik och datavetenskap. Studenterna förbereds för att ta itu med moderna tekniska utmaningar med hjälp av beräkningsverktyg, maskininlärning och simuleringsteknik. Programmet är utformat för studenter som har en bakgrund inom maskinteknik, materialvetenskap eller relaterade områden och som vill fördjupa sin expertis inom digitala och datadrivna metoder.
search_description: The Master’s programme in Data-Driven Mechanical Engineering offers a unique blend of mechanical engineering and data science, preparing students to tackle modern engineering challenges using computational tools, machine learning, and simulation technologies. The programme is designed for students with a background in mechanical engineering, materials science, or related fields who want to deepen their expertise in digital and data-driven methods.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or comparable, including at least 75 ECTS credits in mechanical engineering or materials engineering. Applicants must also have: - At least 22.5 ECTS credits in mathematics - At least 7.5 ECTS credits in programming or data processing - At least 7.5 ECTS credits in solid mechanics - At least 7.5 ECTS credits in materials engineering - At least 7.5 ECTS credits in production systems or mechanical design. English B / English 6 or equivalent is also required.

title: Master's Programme in Physics - Nanomaterials
description: Are you interested in the various challenges regarding the role of new technologies in a modern society and sustainable development? With a master's degree in Engineering physicists you will have a broad knowledge of general and applied physics. With a thorough understanding of physical phenomena on the nanometer scale, including its characterisation and utilisation, you can contribute to the development of new technological applications. The main focus for this program is nanotechnology, in which the quantum structure of matter is used to develop new applications, for instance, molecular electronics, organic solar cells and quantum computers.
description_sv: Lockar utmaningar inom teknik, design av material, teknikens roll i samhället, hållbar utveckling och fysikaliskt modellbyggande? Med en Masterutbildning i fysik får du en bred kompetens där kunskaper inom grundläggande och tillämpad fysik kan användas inom många olika teknikområden. Med en fördjupad förståelse för fysikaliska fenomen på nanometerskala samt dess karakterisering och användande, kommer du att kunna delta i framväxten av nya teknologiska tillämpningar. Fokus för denna utbildning är nanoteknikområdet, där materiens kvantstruktur används för att finna nya tillämpningar som molekylär elektronik, organiska solceller och kvantdatorer.

title: Master's Programme in Physics - Theoretical physics
title_sv: Masterprogram i fysik - Inriktning teoretisk fysik
description: Are you looking for challenges like mathematical physics, quantum field theory and general relativity, and curious what these theories might be useful for in practice? With a Master in Theoretical Physics, you get broad competence where knowledge about fundamental physics can be used in many different areas. You can participate in the development of new technological applications. The focus of this program is the connection between basic physics like quantum field theory and emergent areas like quantum materials, that are used today for finding new applications like molecular electronics, new kinds of solar cells or fuel cells, or quantum computers.
description_sv:
Lockar utmaningar som matematisk fysik, kvantfältteori och allmän relativitetsteori, och är du nyfiken hur de teorierna kan användas i praktiken? Med master i teoretisk fysik får du bred kompetens där kunskaper inom grundläggande fysik kan användas inom många olika områden.
Du kommer att kunna delta i framväxten av nya teknologiska tillämpningar. Fokus för denna utbildning är koppling mellan grundläggande fysik som kvantfältteori och nyare områden inom kvantmaterial, som idag används för att finna nya tillämpningar som bl.a. molekylär elektronik, nya sorters solceller eller bränseceller, och kvantdatorer.

title: GeoAI for Sustainable Futures
description: The Master’s Programme in *GeoAI for Sustainable Futures* combines geospatial science with artificial intelligence (AI) to address pressing challenges in climate change, sustainability, and risk management. Students acquire advanced skills in geospatial data engineering, spatial statistics, machine and deep learning, and cloud-based environmental monitoring. The curriculum emphasises applied open-source GeoAI solutions for sustainable development, disaster-risk reduction, and evidence-based decision support. Graduates will be prepared for careers as GeoAI analysts, GIS developers, data engineers, climate and risk analysts, or decision-support specialists in government agencies, consulting firms, technology companies, and NGOs. The programme also provides an excellent foundation for further research and doctoral studies. Delivered in a hybrid format with both campus and online participation, the programme offers a flexible and research-led education that leverages open data, open-source software, and strong links to national and international partners.
description_sv: Masterprogrammet i GeoAI för hållbara framtider kombinerar geospatial vetenskap med artificiell intelligens (AI) för att ta itu med akuta utmaningar inom klimatförändringar, hållbarhet och riskhantering. Studenterna förvärvar avancerade kunskaper inom geospatial datateknik, rumslig statistik, maskininlärning och djupinlärning samt molnbaserad miljöövervakning. Läroplanen lägger tonvikt på tillämpade open-source GeoAI-lösningar för hållbar utveckling, katastrofriskreducering och evidensbaserat beslutsstöd. Studenterna förbereds för karriärer som GeoAI-analytiker, GIS-utvecklare, dataingenjörer, klimat- och riskanalytiker eller beslutsstödsspecialister inom myndigheter, konsultföretag, teknikföretag och icke-statliga organisationer. Programmet ger också en utmärkt grund för vidare forskning och doktorandstudier. Programmet levereras i ett hybridformat med både campus- och online-deltagande och erbjuder en flexibel och forskningsledd utbildning som utnyttjar öppna data, öppen källkodsprogramvara och starka kopplingar till nationella och internationella partners.

title: GeoAI for Sustainable Futures
description: The Master’s Programme in *GeoAI for Sustainable Futures* combines geospatial science with artificial intelligence (AI) to address pressing challenges in climate change, sustainability, and risk management. Students acquire advanced skills in geospatial data engineering, spatial statistics, machine and deep learning, and cloud-based environmental monitoring. The curriculum emphasises applied open-source GeoAI solutions for sustainable development, disaster-risk reduction, and evidence-based decision support. Graduates will be prepared for careers as GeoAI analysts, GIS developers, data engineers, climate and risk analysts, or decision-support specialists in government agencies, consulting firms, technology companies, and NGOs. The programme also provides an excellent foundation for further research and doctoral studies. Delivered in a hybrid format with both campus and online participation, the programme offers a flexible and research-led education that leverages open data, open-source software, and strong links to national and international partners.
description_sv: Masterprogrammet i GeoAI för hållbara framtider kombinerar geospatial vetenskap med artificiell intelligens (AI) för att ta itu med akuta utmaningar inom klimatförändringar, hållbarhet och riskhantering. Studenterna förvärvar avancerade kunskaper inom geospatial datateknik, rumslig statistik, maskininlärning och djupinlärning samt molnbaserad miljöövervakning. Läroplanen lägger tonvikt på tillämpade open-source GeoAI-lösningar för hållbar utveckling, katastrofriskreducering och evidensbaserat beslutsstöd. Studenterna förbereds för karriärer som GeoAI-analytiker, GIS-utvecklare, dataingenjörer, klimat- och riskanalytiker eller beslutsstödsspecialister inom myndigheter, konsultföretag, teknikföretag och icke-statliga organisationer. Programmet ger också en utmärkt grund för vidare forskning och doktorandstudier. Programmet levereras i ett hybridformat med både campus- och online-deltagande och erbjuder en flexibel och forskningsledd utbildning som utnyttjar öppna data, öppen källkodsprogramvara och starka kopplingar till nationella och internationella partners.

description: In computer science, development is advancing rapidly. Therefore, the programme at Karlstad University focuses on equipping students with the ability to continuously acquire and apply new knowledge. The education also aims to provide students with in-depth competence in the field of computer science, with a focus on intelligent communication systems.
description_sv: Inom datavetenskap går utvecklingen snabbt framåt. title: Sustainable Systems Engineering and Assessment: Nordic perspectives
title_sv: Systemteknik och bedömning för hållbar utveckling: nordiska perspektiv (Internationell antagningsomgång)
description: Are you ready to contribute to the global transformation towards sustainable energy and environmental solutions? The Master’s Programme in Environmental and Energy Systems: Sustainable Systems Engineering and Assessment – Nordic Perspectives at Karlstad University offers you the knowledge, skills, and international outlook needed to shape a sustainable future. Sweden is globally recognised for its leadership in sustainability, clean energy, and environmental policy. This programme combines engineering, sustainability science, and systems analysis to address the complex challenges of energy and resource use. Through a Nordic perspective, you gain insights into one of the world’s most advanced regions in renewable energy and environmental governance.
